name: research_deep
description: Run a multi-source deep research on a topic and return a curated summary plus a research_id for follow-up reads.

arguments.name: include_context
arguments.desc: Whether to include surrounding context in the response. Strict-bool.

name: research_quick_search
description: Fast single-query web search returning the top hits with snippets.

name: research_get_context
description: Fetch the full research context for a given research_id. Output is wrapped with a [SECURITY WARNING:...] prefix to mark untrusted content.

arguments.name: research_id
arguments.desc: The ID returned by a previous research_deep call.

name: research_get_sources
description: Fetch the list of sources (URLs, titles, snippets) for a given research_id. Output is wrapped with a [SECURITY WARNING:...] prefix.

arguments.name: research_id
arguments.desc: The ID returned by a previous research_deep call.

name: research_write_report
description: Write a long-form report for a given research_id and return the file path or markdown body.

arguments.name: research_id
arguments.desc: The ID returned by a previous research_deep call.

arguments.name: custom_prompt
arguments.desc: Optional override prompt for the synthesis step.
